simple.summary: חָיֶה (châyeh) means vigorous First listed occurrence: Exod 1 19.

definitions.full: H2422. chayeh [ חָיֶה ] adjective having the vigour of life, lively (on formation see Lag BN 49 ) — feminine plural חָיוֺת Exod 1:19 (E), of Hebrew women in childbirth, bearing quickly easily.
